parole.significato: crust (dry, hard dirt, especially as developed due to burning)
parole.testo: Possibly borrowed from Slavic (compare Russian коро́ста (korósta)). However, compare karsi and karttua; for the -st- ~ -tt- variation, compare varsta. If the word is indeed of Slavic origin, it was likely nevertheless at least semantically influenced by karsi.

parole.significato: aphid, commonly also plant louse or greenfly, blackfly, whitefly according to color
parole.testo: Uncertain; possibly from Slavic (compare Russian червь (červʹ)) or alternatively related to kirppu.

parole.significato: ploughbeam; shaft of a plough; draft pole of a plough
parole.testo: oja (“ploughbeam”) (dialectal) + -s, perhaps borrowed from Slavic (compare dialectal Russian воё (vojó)), ultimately from Proto-Slavic *ȍje. Cognate with Ingrian ojapuu, Ludian oja (“ploughbeam”), Veps oja (“ploughbeam”).
From the Slavic word sloboda (“freedom”) through some means, probably through some form of Russian слобода́ (slobodá) (compare also the South Slavic given name Слободан).
